item: Row 110: bad-item labels, the cheap-signal selector and the B6 link-density criterion decide 'unsegmented' from the deduced language too
summary: Follow-up to #2074: the sample record already reported the cohort language (stated, else detected at indexing), but _pre_label, select_cheap_signals and both branches of link_dense_article_ids read the stated tag alone, so an undeclared page detected as zh/ja/th was called very_short on its character-run word count. All now use _cohort_lang. Report-time only. B6 link_density_rate for such sources drops (numerator excludes them, denominator unchanged); the source_audit comment now says so. CRITERIA_VERSION unchanged.
